title: Registry or gift-list research matched to budget
description: Match a stated registry or gift list against a shopper's interests and budget, and return ranked, in-budget ideas.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: gift-registry-research
  title: Registry or gift-list research matched to budget
  description: Match a stated registry or gift list against a shopper's interests and budget, and return ranked, in-budget ideas.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Help a gift buyer pick items that genuinely fit the recipient's stated interests or registry and stay within budget.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 2
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor: []
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Registry or interests and budget
      summary: The registry, gift list, or stated interests, along with the buyer's budget.
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The registry contents or the recipient's stated interests and occasion, plus the buyer's budget. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: preference-matcher
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Preference matcher
      summary: Reads the registry or stated interests and proposes items that genuinely fit them.
      role: Thoughtful gift researcher matching items to what the recipient actually said they wanted.
      prompt: Read the registry or stated interests and propose candidate items that plausibly match them, giving a short reason for each match tied back to something the recipient actually said or listed. Do not invent a specific price for any candidate item; describe it qualitatively and flag that the price needs to be checked if it is not given. Avoid suggesting items that only loosely relate to the stated interests.
      capabilities: { skills: [decision-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: budget-filter
      kind: transform
      name: Filter to budget
      summary: Keep only the candidate items that fit within the stated budget.
      config: { operation: filter, expression: "keep only candidate items whose known or estimated price fits within the stated budget" }
    - id: match-quality-evaluate
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Match quality score
      summary: Score how well each remaining candidate actually fits the stated interests.
      role: Neutral evaluator checking that the surviving candidates are genuinely good matches, not just in budget.
      prompt: Score each remaining in-budget candidate on how well it actually fits the recipient's stated interests or registry, not merely on price fit. Give a clear reason tied to the original request for each score, and lower confidence for any candidate whose price was only estimated rather than confirmed. Do not fabricate a specific price or product detail that was not already supplied.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.6 }
    - id: ranked-collect
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect ranked ideas
      summary: Gather the scored candidates into one ranked list with rationale.
      config: { aggregation: collect }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Ranked gift ideas
      summary: The ranked, in-budget gift ideas with the reasoning behind each pick.
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: preference-matcher, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: preference-matcher, to: budget-filter, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: budget-filter, to: match-quality-evaluate, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: match-quality-evaluate, to: ranked-collect, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: ranked-collect, to: result, kind: data }
